scope: Reproducible event-boundary contract; no estimator, solver, BDF policy, cooldown, GPU, or production changes

tes_programs.recording_commit_note: main contains the requested base, the subsequent summary commit, and an archive commit

event_contract.event_clipped: The proposed endpoint is strictly beyond event + epsilon; final_dt is reduced to event - time.
event_contract.event_landing: The final trial endpoint is within epsilon of the physical event, including endpoints on either side before normalization.
event_contract.event_endpoint_snapped: The landing endpoint was numerically different from event and was normalized to event.
event_contract.event_forced: The proposal crossed the event far enough to require clipping; a landing snap alone does not set this flag.
event_contract.final_endpoint_invariant: A landing trial ends at the physical event and never remains beyond it.

bdf_history_contract.accepted_history: Accepted state is committed once; the previous accepted history is shifted and the trial-start state is retained as the older BDF history entry.
bdf_history_contract.rejection: Rejected trials restore values, PrevValues, DoneTime, and order; accepted history is not advanced. Rejection forces BDF1 for the retry and preserves the existing one-step recovery cooldown.
bdf_history_contract.python_native_sequence: landing BDF1 -> immediate post-event BDF1 -> following ordinary BDF2
